versions.prompt: Small jazz combo: brushed snare, upright bass and a light piano or vibraphone, a friendly easy swing, like a café on a shopping street. 110 BPM. Relaxed everyday background music for a slice-of-life video game, instrumental only, no vocals. Sparse, unhurried and easy to listen to for a long time. No strings section, no orchestra, nothing epic or dramatic, no big build-up or climax. No ending: it keeps the same calm level to the end so it can loop.
